bio: The luxury De Tuilerieën Hotel is the kind of place that leaves you with unforgettable souvenirs, as does its restaurant, Mémoire, whose two dining rooms are appointed in a stylish, cosy vein that mingles a casual vibe with a minimalist ethos. The only incongruity in this tranquil portrait is the exuberant, flavoursome cuisine of Wouter Van Tichelen. This classically trained chef, as his flair for sauces demonstrates, adds an elegant contemporary note to his handiwork, taking his cooking to new heights of culinary elegance. The chef might impart a mineral edge to halibut marinated in salt, courtesy of a sorrel and briny seaweed crème, before exalting these delicate flavours with a final flourish by way of a caviar quenelle and a glass of Albariño wine.
